ModMetaData.name: Arkh
ModMetaData.author: Ethan
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists who talk, and who remember.
Arkh generates colony dialogue with a language model of your choosing, and builds it around a memory system rather than a transcript. Memories are scored for weight and for how much they matter right now, and the ones that belong together surface together — so a colonist recalls the raid and the person they lost in it in the same breath.
Around that sits the talking itself: - Prompt blocks you can read and edit, with separate voices by age and by gender. - World and colony lore every pawn speaks from. - Distance rules for who can hear what, and how far a shout carries. - Whisper, shout and thought as distinct ways of speaking. - A character budget, so background text gives way before anything that matters to the moment.
Works with OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama and LM Studio.
NOT COMPATIBLE WITH RIMTALK. Arkh replaces it rather than extending it — running both means two mods generating dialogue for the same colonists, and paying for every line twice.
Early development. Requires Harmony and Interaction Bubbles — Bubbles already draws speech above colonists better than a second implementation would, so Arkh uses it rather than competing with it.
